# Personal defaults

Sample user memory for the tests; none of this is a real instruction.

## Style

- Always use tabs for indentation in TypeScript files.
- Keep answers short and direct.
- Prefer small functions over long ones.
- Keep answers short and direct.
- Write commit messages in the imperative mood.
- Never use emojis in replies.
- Use British spelling in documentation, except in code identifiers.
- Vždy píš dokumentáciu po anglicky, okrem používateľských textov.
- A literal <script>alert("x")</script> tag must stay text, unless it sits in a code sample.

## Tools

- Always run `npm test` before committing.
- After editing a TypeScript file, format it with prettier.
- Po každej úprave spusti testy.
- Never run `git push --force` on a shared branch.
- When I say "ship it", run the release checklist and tag the version.
- Do not commit generated files.
  - Unless the file is a lockfile.

## Release procedure

1. Update the version number in the manifest.
2. Run the full test suite.
3. Write the release notes.
4. Tag the commit.
5. Publish the package.

## Project notes

- In alpha-service the API handlers live under `src/api`.
- Use cargo clippy on every Rust change.
